title: JournalSnapshot
description: Full serializable snapshot of Nepenthe Journal's data store. Used for JSON file persistence, backup/restore, and seed data. Version 7 adds persons, tombstones, ratingScaleMode, welcomeCompleted and seedFingerprint over v5, drops the legacy docType discriminator the serializer no longer writes, and describes the exact fields of JournalSnapshot (CURRENT_VERSION = 7). Validate v5-era files against journal-snapshot-v5.json.

version.description: Schema version number. CURRENT_VERSION = 7 (must match JournalSnapshot.CURRENT_VERSION; asserted by SnapshotSchemaTest). Files from older app versions carry their own lower number and validate against their own journal-snapshot-v{N}.json.

savedAt.description: Unix millisecond timestamp when this snapshot was written. UTC.

sessions.description: Journal sessions. Each session groups one or more doses (ingestions) under a single experience.

substances.description: Substance library. Pure compounds use 'cid:{PubChemCID}' as ID (e.g. 'cid:5761' for LSD). Plants or mixtures without a single CID use 'pwiki:{name}' fallback. The seed files ship ~325 substances.

doses.description: Individual ingestion records. Each dose belongs to exactly one session and references one substance.

notes.description: User notes attached to sessions, doses, or standalone.

timelineEvents.description: Time-stamped events during a session: onset markers, observations, side effects, check-ins.

interactions.description: Pairwise substance interaction risks from TripSit + SMW data. Queried bidirectionally by substanceAId or substanceBId.

effects.description: Named psychoactive effects with descriptions and category groupings.

customUnits.description: User-defined dosing units beyond mg/ug: drops, puffs, tabs, sprays, etc.

persons.description: Device-local individuals (never synced). The PARTICIPANT assigned via session.personId owns that trip's demographics.

tombstones.description: Deletion journal: storage key (e.g. 'session:uuid') -> epoch ms when deleted. Replaces the tombstone journal wholesale on restore.

ratingScaleMode.description: Rating scale mode. Null (or absent) means the file predates the mode: fall back to the legacy useShulginRating flag.

useShulginRating.description: When true, the app uses the Shulgin rating scale (+/- to ++++) instead of a numeric 1-10 rating for sessions.

useSubstanceColors.description: When true, each substance class gets an adaptive color tag in the UI.

welcomeCompleted.description: Whether the first-run welcome flow has been completed.

seedFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the bundled resources the substance library was last ingested from. Null means unknown: ingest unconditionally.

obsidianVaultPath.description: Absolute filesystem path to the user's Obsidian vault directory for auto-export.

obsidianAutoExport.description: When true, sessions are automatically exported as Obsidian markdown notes.

obsidianSubfolder.description: Subfolder name within the Obsidian vault where journal notes are placed.

obsidianFileOrganization.description: File organization strategy inside Obsidian: 'flat' (all files in subfolder) or 'nested' (year/month structure).

showSessionsTrendChart.description: When true, shows a sessions-per-week trend chart on the dashboard.

VaultDocument.description: Common identifier block every persisted entity carries. The former docType discriminator is gone: current writes never emit it (older files may still contain it; unknown keys are ignored on decode).

id.description: Stable unique identifier. Format varies by entity: 'cid:5761' for substances, UUIDs for user-created entities (sessions, doses, notes). Device-keyed IDs prevent structural conflicts in sync.

createdAt.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of creation. UTC.

updatedAt.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of last modification. UTC.

deviceOrigin.description: Device that created this document. Used for sync conflict resolution. 'system' for bundled seed data, device fingerprint for user-generated content.

Substance.description: A substance entry in the library. Pure compounds are keyed by PubChem CID; plants and mixtures use a PsychonautWiki name fallback. Data merged from 8 sources via the ETL pipeline.

id.description: Primary identifier. 'cid:{PubChemCID}' for pure compounds, 'pwiki:{name}' for plants/mixtures.

oldId.description: Previous identifier before CID migration. Preserved for session reference compatibility.

cid.description: PubChem Compound ID. Null for plants/mixtures without a single compound identifier.

deviceOrigin.description: 'system' for bundled data. Custom for user-created substances.

name.description: Display name. Usually the common English name.

aliases.description: Alternative names, street names, abbreviations. Merged from PsychonautWiki SMW, TripSit, PubChem synonyms, and Wikidata.

summary.description: Paragraph-length substance description. From PsychonautWiki SMW.

substanceClass.description: Chemical and psychoactive classifications. Includes both chemical families (e.g. 'Lysergamides') and effect categories (e.g. 'Psychedelic', 'Stimulant'). Case/plural variants are not normalized across sources.

routesOfAdministration.description: Valid administration routes. Values from PsychonautWiki SMW schema. Capitalized English: 'Oral', 'Sublingual', 'Insufflated', 'Inhalation', 'Smoked', 'Intravenous', 'Intramuscular', 'Subcutaneous', 'Rectal', 'Transdermal', 'Buccal', 'Topical', 'Ophthalmic'.

dosageBands.description: Typical dosage ranges per route. Keys are route names, values are string-formatted dose bands. Not all routes have data. Empty object means no dose data available.

durationProfile.description: Typical duration ranges per phase. Keys are route names, values contain onset/comeup/peak/offset/total strings. Format varies.

addictionPotential.description: Addiction/addiction potential classification from SMW. Free text or structured label.

toxicity.description: Toxicity warnings as free-text strings. From SMW data.

crossTolerances.description: Substance names this substance has cross-tolerance with. From SMW.

effects.description: Psychoactive effect labels. Free-text strings from PsychonautWiki SMW. Not structured: use DoseWiki subjective_effects for structured effect data.

interactionClasses.description: Pharmacological interaction classes for the deterministic interaction checker. Values: 'maoi', 'ssri', 'serotonin_releaser', 'serotonergic', 'stimulant', 'depressant', 'benzodiazepine', 'opioid', 'psychedelic', 'dissociative', 'lithium', 'cannabinoid', 'deliriant'.

chemblId.description: ChEMBL molecule identifier. From Wikidata cross-reference.

iupharId.description: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY ligand ID. From Wikidata.

unii.description: FDA UNII (Unique Ingredient Identifier). From Wikidata.

chebiId.description: ChEBI (Chemical Entities of Biological Interest) identifier. From Wikidata.

atcCode.description: WHO ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) classification code. From Wikidata.

sources.description: Data source provenance tags. Each entry identifies which source contributed data for this substance. Possible values: 'psychonautwiki', 'pubchem', 'tripsit', 'wikidata', 'chembl', 'iuphar', 'pdsp', 'bindingdb'.

cachedAt.description: Unix millisecond timestamp when this substance data was last refreshed from source APIs.

sourceVersion.description: Version tag for the ETL pipeline run that produced this substance record. Format: '{source}-{type}-v{number}' e.g. 'pwiki-smw-v2'.

curatedSections.description: Curated DoseWiki taxonomy tags (category + section) for this substance.

wikipediaData.description: Affinity values harvested from Wikipedia receptor tables.

ChemicalProperties.description: Molecular properties from PubChem compound record. Present for substances with a valid PubChem CID.

molecularWeight.description: Molecular weight in daltons, as a string to preserve precision.

inchiKey.description: Standard InChIKey (hash of the full InChI).

xlogP.description: Predicted octanol/water partition coefficient (XLogP3-AA). Higher values = more lipophilic.

hBondDonorCount.description: Number of hydrogen bond donor sites.

hBondAcceptorCount.description: Number of hydrogen bond acceptor sites.

Bioactivity.description: Single bioactivity measurement from ChEMBL: binding affinity or functional assay result at a molecular target.

value.description: Numerical activity value in the units specified.

relation.description: Qualifier: '=', '<', '>', '~'. Indicates whether value is exact, a limit, or approximate.

targetId.description: ChEMBL target identifier (e.g. 'CHEMBL_TARGET:1234') or target name.

assay.description: Assay description or ChEMBL assay ID.

ChemblData.description: ChEMBL molecule data summary including calculated properties and bioactivity measurements.

prefName.description: ChEMBL preferred name for the molecule.

mw.description: Molecular weight (exact) from ChEMBL, in daltons.

alogp.description: Predicted logP from ChEMBL's ALOGPS model.

psa.description: Polar surface area in square angstroms.

maxPhase.description: Maximum clinical trial phase reached (0-4). 0 = no clinical development, 4 = approved.

bioactivities.description: Bioactivity measurements (IC50, Ki, EC50, Kd) at molecular targets.

IupharInteraction.description: A single interaction record from the IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY: a ligand's binding or functional interaction with a target.

affinity.description: Quantitative affinity as a formatted string with value, parameter type, and units.

endogenous.description: True if this ligand is an endogenous compound for the target.

primaryTarget.description: True if this is the designated primary target of the ligand.

IupharData.description: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY pharmacology data: ligand ID and interaction records.

interactions.description: Ligand-target interaction records with affinity data.

PdspKiRecord.description: A single Ki binding measurement from the PDSP (Psychoactive Drug Screening Program) Ki database. Ki values in nanomolar (nM). Lower values = stronger binding affinity.

gene.description: Human gene symbol for the target.

reference.description: Citation reference (PMID or short citation string).

source.description: Data source label, e.g. 'PDSP Ki Database', 'Roth Lab'.

PdspData.description: PDSP Ki database pharmacology data wrapper. Contains Ki binding affinity measurements at CNS molecular targets. Maintained by the NIMH PDSP program (Roth Lab at UNC).

records.description: Ki binding records for this substance at various CNS targets.

BindingdbRecord.description: A single binding affinity measurement from BindingDB. Affinity values in nanomolar (nM). Curated from published literature.

uniprotId.description: UniProt identifier of the target protein.

pmid.description: PubMed ID of the publication reporting this measurement.

BindingdbData.description: BindingDB pharmacology data wrapper. Experimentally measured binding affinities at protein targets. Curated by the BindingDB project.

records.description: Binding affinity records for this substance at various targets.

Session.description: A journal session representing a single experience. Groups doses, timeline events, notes, and check-ins. The core unit of journaling.

id.description: UUID v4 or device-keyed unique ID.

title.description: Session title. Usually auto-generated from substance names and date, but user-editable.

startTime.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of session start (when first dose was taken).

endTime.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of session end. Null while session is live.

tags.description: User-applied tags for filtering and categorization.

set.description: Mindset: the user's mental state before the session.

setting.description: Setting: the physical and social environment of the session.

intention.description: User's stated intention or goal for the session.

outcome.description: User's reflection on how the session went.

shulginRating.description: Shulgin rating scale: '+/-' (not sure), '+' (mild), '++' (moderate), '+++' (strong), '++++' (very strong). Used when useShulginRating is true.

checkins.description: In-session check-in snapshots: intensity, effect scores, mood, and notes at a point in time.

isArchived.description: When true, session is hidden from the main list but still searchable.

isFavorite.description: When true, session is marked as a favorite for quick access.

consumerName.description: Name of the person who took the substances (for multi-user journals). Null = the journal owner.

personId.description: ID of the Person (individual) assigned to this session; null = unassigned.

profile.description: Legacy inline demographics for the session. Used only when session.personId is null; new sessions use a Person instead.

pausedMs.description: Milliseconds accumulated in earlier pauses of the live timer.

pausedAt.description: Wall-clock ms when the live timer was paused; null while running.

CheckIn.description: An in-session check-in recording the user's state at a specific time.

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of the check-in.

overallIntensity.description: Overall subjective intensity of the experience at this point, 0.0 to 1.0 (or 0-100%).

effectScores.description: Per-effect intensity scores. Keys are effect names, values are 0.0-1.0 scores.

mood.description: Mood label at time of check-in.

Dose.description: An individual ingestion record. Belongs to exactly one session and references one substance.

sessionId.description: ID of the parent session. Links doses to sessions.

amount.description: Dose amount in the specified unit.

unit.description: Unit of measurement: 'mg', 'µg', 'ug', 'ml', 'drops', 'puffs', 'tabs', 'sprays', or custom unit name.

redosing.description: True if this is a redose (taken after the initial dose, during the same session).

isDoseEstimate.description: True if the dose amount is estimated rather than exactly measured.

estimatedDoseStandardDeviation.description: Standard deviation of the estimate when isDoseEstimate is true.

customUnitId.description: If using a custom unit, the ID of the CustomUnit definition.

stomachFullness.description: Stomach fullness at time of ingestion (enum entry names; UI labels are 'Empty', 'Light snack', 'Moderate meal', 'Full meal'). Null = not recorded.

Interaction.description: A pairwise substance interaction risk assessment. From TripSit interaction chart + PsychonautWiki SMW.

riskLevel.description: Risk level: DANGEROUS = life-threatening, UNSAFE = significant risk, UNCERTAIN = unknown or debated, LOW = generally safe combination, UNKNOWN = no data.

description.description: Human-readable description of the interaction mechanism and risks.

sources.description: Source citations for this interaction assessment.

Effect.description: A named psychoactive effect with optional description and category.

url.description: URL to external reference or PsychonautWiki page for this effect.

substanceIds.description: IDs of substances known to produce this effect.

Note.description: A user note. Can be attached to a session, a dose, or standalone (no parent). Supports conflict resolution via sibling tracking.

sessionId.description: Parent session ID, if attached to a session.

doseId.description: Parent dose ID, if attached to a dose.

conflictSiblings.description: Conflict siblings produced during sync when multiple devices edited the same note concurrently. UI must render a conflict banner when non-empty.

ConflictSibling.description: A conflicting version of a note from another device, produced during sync.

deviceOrigin.description: The device that produced this version.

updatedAt.description: When this version was last modified.

TimelineEvent.description: A timestamped event within a session. Used for the session timeline view.

timestamp.description: Unix millisecond timestamp of the event.

label.description: Short human-readable label for the event.

body.description: Detailed description or notes for the event.

CustomUnit.description: A user-defined dosing unit for flexible measurement: drops, puffs, tabs, sprays, etc.

substanceId.description: ID of the substance this unit applies to.

description.description: Optional description of what this unit means.

isEstimate.description: When true, the estimatedMgPerUnit is approximate and doses using this unit should display '~' prefix.

Person.description: An individual known to the journal. Device-local: never synced, never tombstoned.

createdAt.description: Epoch ms when the individual record was created.

updatedAt.description: Epoch ms of the last update.

role.description: Role in a session. PARTICIPANT owns trip demographics.

height.description: Free text with unit, e.g. '5 ft 8 in' or '175 cm'.

weight.description: Free text with unit, e.g. '150 lb' or '68 kg'.

contactEmail.description: Contact for exported reports; only shared with mayContact.

mayContact.description: Editors may write back when exported.

isSelf.description: True for the device owner's own roster entry.

SessionProfile.description: Legacy inline demographics attached to a session (pre-Person).

CuratedSection.description: One curated DoseWiki taxonomy tag: category, section within it, display label.

section.description: Section inside the category ('all' when category-level).

WikipediaData.description: Binding affinity records harvested from Wikipedia receptor tables.

WikipediaRecord.description: Single affinity row: target, Ki/EC50/IC50 in nM, efficacy, species.

kiNMMin.description: Range minimum when Ki is a range.

kiNMMax.description: Range maximum when Ki is a range.

rawText.description: Raw affinity cell text as found.
